page.notes: Greek in the first paragraph is copied from a small, partly worn scan; "ὀλιγωρίαν" and the phrase after "τὸ μηδὲν ἄγαν" are doubtful and marked [?]. The printed "cùm", "quę", "rectè", "funt", "aduerfiffima", "fiue" and "cōtraria" are kept as printed. The printed "superbia" and "superstitio" keep the long s as a plain s. The right edge is a dark strip from the neighbouring page and is not transcribed. The two faint marks at the bottom left are not legible and are not transcribed. A small asterisk-like sign stands at the left of the last line, beside "certatio"; it is not transcribed.
